review_description: Darren arrived and explained everything in great detail as well as made sure we understood everything. The system was installed within 2 weeks. Boys installing got everything done in one day and our system was up and running the same day. Can’t fault the company they were very professional and extremely helpful from start to finish.

Darren clearly explained the benefits of an Enphase system of solar panels and micro-inverters. He and his support staff communicated well throughout the whole process. The installation went very smoothly. We are now enjoying the ability to monitor the system via the Enphase app. I look forward to gathering data to inform our choice of adding batteries to our system later this year.
Darren from Transparent Solutions was excellent with quoting and his after sales service. His install electrician was also excellent. Would definitely recommend.
Everything was fast and easy through the entire process. No complaints
Advice given suited our situation, explained very well. Installation was done efficiently and on time. System working well.

Darren from Transparentsolarsolutions was polite and punctual. He listened to our requirements and offered us his advice based on experience. The recommendation was for a split system of 11 panels (4.84kw) with 11 micro inverters. Six panels are facing north and five west. The installer was Michael Rosler who also proved to be punctual and customer focused. The installation is of very high quality and the system performs better than I imagined from my research.Darren arranged everything for us. All we had to do was advise of our availability.

Darren and the team were fantastic to deal with from start to finish.Rapid on quotes and willing to be flexible, incredibly prompt and installation was rapid and professional. They also followed up afterwards to ensure everything was satisfactory!
Everything went smoothly. Installed within 2 weeks of quotationHappy with the whole process
How was the sales/quoting process? Excellent!How did the installation go? Excellent!How was the customer service? Excellent!
Punctual installation. Energy retailer has not converted meter yet so too early to say more.

The pricing for our solar was competitive and the whole system was explained to us clearly at a level we could understand. The installation was done on the due date with no issues. The installers were polite and professional. The grid connection was organised by Transparent solar and Darren ( salesperson) also helped us organise a suitable plan with our energy supplier. I would recommend Transparent solar solutions to anyone interested in using solar power in their home as I also believe the products they sell are of good quality.

Darren was prompt to contact me and carry out a site visit, his input into choosing a system was honest and helpful. The installation by Todd and his team was very professional and on time. I would happily recommend Transparent Solar Solutions to others.

Very happy with the service and information supplied by Transparent Solar Solutions.The sales person visited the site promptly and discussed options.The installation was carried out by Todd Basham Electrical from Young who installed the system with-in one week of accepting the quote.  They were efficient, polite and had it working the same afternoon.All the paper work etc for rebate and meter change were organised by Transparent Solar Solutions.Thus far the meter has not been changed but this has been the fault of the energy provider not Transparent Solar nor Todd Basham Electrical.
